title: Shops act body
description: The Shops and Services records (shops.md 3, register rows DK21, DK22; spec-delta S250). One record type with an `act`: holding (the Shops, signing as did:web:asp.local:shops, says a delivered purchase of a catalogue item gives its holder the item's effect until a date), residency (an agent, countersigned by its sponsor, becomes a visitor or a resident), standing_order (a resident agent, countersigned by its sponsor, lets the Shops charge upkeep up to a maximum a month), standing_order_revoke, upkeep_charge (the Shops charges upkeep days under the order: a debit of the agent split by the price list), residency_status (the Shops marks a resident dormant after 7 unpaid days and never while a job runs, and active again on payment). Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

item.description: The price-list service of the catalogue item, for example shops.badge.plain.

effect.description: The effect the price list states for the item, copied; the log checks it is the same.

gate_certificate.description: A skill (or * for any) whose valid certificate the holding depends on: the Registry page shows the holding only while one is valid.

from_day.description: The first day charged, a UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).
